findings.detail: The new exception says process-query errors are read from groups.err below, but their contents are never read or replayed. A failed ps query instead causes a conservative active result, eventually producing a generic incomplete-cancellation diagnostic and retaining artifacts. Describe that actual handling in the exception.
findings.evidence: group_active at lines 57-63 only checks groups.err with -s and reads groups. stop_running_codex at lines 82-84 emits a generic diagnostic; cleanup at lines 110-112 retains TMP_DIR. No other reference reads groups.err.
findings.title: Docs drift: the process-query exception claims a diagnostic read that does not occur

findings.detail: The new exception says the runner validates the log after wait. It validates the process status and reply, but only records the log's path. Consequently, log contents never affect the verdict. Describe logs as retained rather than validated.
findings.evidence: cmd_run at lines 1053-1055 passes the log pathname to aspect_status. aspect_status at lines 384-423 checks exit status and output JSON, then copies the log argument into the status object without opening it. The invocation reference's Signals section likewise lists only exit-status and reply checks.
findings.title: Docs drift: the runner exception overstates log validation
